Switching needs the screen lock off (PIN, pattern, password, fingerprint and face). It keeps One UI\'s data safe if something goes wrong.

The app switches the device from One UI to another system without flashing. Things may break.
Back up your accounts and critical data first.
Apps in the other system get the same root privileges as One UI. Data is not shared, but anything that touches the system will have full access. Be sensible.
